question: How did Ausable trick Max into jumping out of the window? 🪟
options: He made up a convincing story about a non-existent balcony 🏙️
He told him the police had brought a ladder 🪜
He promised him a secret escape route 🗺️
answer: He made up a convincing story about a non-existent balcony 🏙️
explanation: Spot on! Ausable used his quick wit to invent a story about a balcony outside the window. When someone knocked, Max panicked, jumped to the 'balcony', and fell to his death. 🧠
hint: Ausable used his imagination to create a fake architectural feature outside his room.

question: What is the central theme of 'The Midnight Visitor'? 🎭
